“No! There’s one more down there! There were six of us!”

“I guess you could say that Kno-Dearg Manor gave me a new lease on life because I’ve felt the need to change a lot since then.”
The man, now an eerily different person, extended his hand to Jin-ah.
“Consider the old Lan Isford dead.”

As a subtle tension began to rise between them, Hye-jun realized that he was becoming unusually conscious of Do-jin…
“Don’t worry. Even if the entire human race went extinct and it was just you and me left, I wouldn’t ask you to sleep with me, sir.”
“All the human race? Just the two of us?”
“Yeah.”
“If it’s just the two of us, why wouldn’t you ask?”
“…What?”
“If there was just us, feel free to ask. I’ll gladly say yes.”

106236.synopsis:

Sia, who always lamented, ‘Why am I the only one without a cat?’, ended up chasing after a stray cat—only to be transported to another dimension.
The place she arrived in was the Pelles Empire, the land of cat werebeasts.
Though she was initially frightened after being dropped into an unfamiliar world, that fear quickly faded as she basked in what felt like a paradise for cat lovers.
Then, she encountered a strikingly beautiful black-maned male cat…
***
She looked down at the cat nestled quietly in her arms, gazing back at her. She had seen many cats since arriving here, but this was the first time she had encountered one with heterochromatic eyes.
“Black fur and odd eyes? Oh, you’re just too charming.”
Sia sat down on a nearby chair and lifted the cat in her arms to meet his gaze. Staring blankly at the strikingly handsome feline face, she couldn’t help herself and kissed him.
Nox’s gold and blue eyes widened in utter disbelief.
“Hehe, I didn’t mean to! You’re just so handsome that I kissed you without thinking!”
He had been too stunned to react properly for a while now. He was experiencing more new things in a single day than he had in his entire life.
“If I could be the butler of a cat as handsome as you, I’d gladly spend my entire salary on you. Please, will you live with me?”
Just like she had always done with stray cats, Sia asked for his permission as if making a marriage proposal.
However, she failed to notice something—the cat’s tail had stiffened straight up.
Sia had no idea.
She didn’t know that all the cats she had encountered in this world were actually cat werebeasts who could shift into animal form.
She didn’t know anything about the ruthless wild instincts that lurked beneath their cute exteriors.
Caught off guard by her words, Nox let himself get swept up in an emotion he couldn’t name, and closed his eyes.
It was a complex feeling, but the decision was simple.
Nox answered with a long, drawn-out meow.
He would allow it.
Yes. He would be with her.

108284.synopsis:
“Ah, him? He’s just Daeyeong’s acquaintance.” He hated those words.
Choi Seolwoo is trying to leave behind his teens and twenties, which he spent as Won Daeyeong’s shadow.
Won Daeyeong (gong), the national team captain who became the first Korean track and field athlete to qualify for the Olympics in the 400m, and Choi Seolwoo (soo), a newly qualified Certified Public Accountant, are childhood friends of over a decade. Choi Seolwoo, weary of the pain of his obsessive unrequited love for Won Daeyeong, impulsively enters into a contractual relationship with a sub-seme and declares a break-up with Won Daeyeong, intending to completely remove him from his life and start anew.
Won Daeyeong is displeased with Choi Seolwoo trying to end their friendship over a relationship. Just how much attention had he demanded since they were young? Even he himself acknowledged how incredibly well he’d treated him. It wasn’t as if he had expected anything in return for looking after him, but still, this is absurd. To take him for granted and push him aside like this.
Won Daeyeong proposes that if Choi Seolwoo appears on five episodes of a segment called “An Acquaintance” on his Xtube channel, which has 1.1 million subscribers, he will agree to the break-up.
The filming of a variety show exposing every detail of Won Daeyeong’s life begins. Unexpectedly, the view count explodes due to the spicy and entertaining talk with frequent bleeps, the genuine bromance chemistry and realistically fierce fights, and Choi Seolwoo’s idol-like visuals. Choi Seolwoo, the “break-up guy,” ends up advertising himself to the entire nation as Won Daeyeong’s best friend.
Wait, somehow this… seems to be moving further away from a break-up…?

109052.synopsis:
I was possessed into an early villain character who only has counter-attack skills.

110844.synopsis:
Yeah, those eyes. I should’ve run away the moment I saw those eyes.
“Did you sleep well?”
It was an impulsive one-night stand. I thought it could be anyone, but I never expected it to be the detective who would later be in charge of my case. The same man who had been rough and relentless the night before, even when I begged and pleaded for mercy.
Inspector Kwon Jeongbaek, whose demeanor was far too fierce to pass as an ordinary civil servant.
“Our sequence of events might be a little mixed up. But we have a lot to talk about. Let’s have a conversation, Witness Jeong Irim.”
The smile he gave as he said that was truly remarkable.
My biggest mistake wasn’t getting drunk. It wasn’t even having a one-night stand. The real problem was him — that man, a demon of the night. Someone so beautiful yet so tragic, he would become the most painful part of my heart.
And Jeongbaek probably had no idea either.
That by meeting me, he’d end up tossing aside the lifelong obsession he’d clung to so desperately — without mercy, without hesitation.
Male Lead:
 Kwon Jeongbaek (33) – Inspector with the Violent Crimes Division 2 of the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency. A cold, indifferent, and well-trained man, like a black steed of muted colors. A strikingly handsome man who lacks certain elements of humanity necessary to live harmoniously in society.

 Jeong Irim (30) – Pediatric ICU doctor at a university hospital. A beauty, serene like an ink wash painting. After meeting the provocative and intense Jeongbaek by chance, she finds herself constantly swayed by him.

111356.synopsis:
One day, Wen Shixue, the daughter of the Wen Group, hits her head and learns that she is living in a romance novel—even worse, she’s not the female lead, but the villainous side character?!
In the plot, after falling in love with the male lead, she turns dark because her love is unrequited. She abandons her billion-dollar inheritance to chase after the male lead all day, becoming the biggest obstacle in the path of the main couple’s love.
Wen Shixue, holding the villainous side character script: Tsk, I must be crazy. [Confused Grandpa on Subway.JPG] 
Being a ‘love brain’ will only leave her with nothing. Isn’t inheriting the family fortune better?
And as for the romance novel protagonists with their halos…
Wen Shixue smiles faintly: Isn’t using them to make money better?
Male Lead/Female Lead: ???
As for falling in love—
Wen Shixue: I’ll be beautiful alone!
Wait a minute, that Vice President Qin Zhen, who taught her how to manage the company and couldn’t be more serious… why does she seem a little appealing?

112380.synopsis:
The last guardian of her world—Haga Mayumi—finally escaped the trap of immortality and embraced the eternal sleep she had longed for… after watching her world fall to ruin.
But when she opened her eyes again, she had been reincarnated into another world.
And this world… was bizarre.
Here, the guardians never get hurt, never bleed. They don’t end up covered in dust and dirt after battle. Their sparkling magic keeps their clothes pristine, and somehow, no matter how much they fly around in frilly skirts, there’s never a wardrobe malfunction.
The guardians of this world are called “magical girls,” with brightly colored hair and flashy outfits. No one knows their true identities.
Or at least, that’s what people say.
But for some reason, Mayumi keeps running into familiar faces—her childhood friend, her classmate, the new transfer student, the school nurse… even that idol she once saw on TV. All of them just so happen to have rare, vibrant hair colors that perfectly match those of the magical girls.
And yet… no one notices anything strange.
Ridiculous.
But what Mayumi doesn’t know is this: in this cheerful, kid-friendly world, the most ridiculous thing of all…
…is her.
The girl who bleeds, who can sew her own severed arm back on and move it again in three minutes, who can blow herself up like a grenade and still regenerate from a puddle of gore—
—is her.

120316.synopsis:
In an apocalyptic world, Wei Huan is reborn 11 years in the past, brimming with determination to participate in the [Highway Survival Challenge] to gain extraordinary abilities and confront the supernatural monsters descending upon the present world.
In his previous life, bound by conventional rules, he missed the chance to enter the forest and open the god-tier treasure chest that was within reach. This time, he won’t let it slip by.
Romance Arc:
On the eve of entering the challenge, Wei Huan is blindsided by an arranged engagement.
His nearly bankrupt father, swayed by his stepmother’s suggestion, plans to marry him off to a disabled man.
Upon meeting, Wei Huan discovers his betrothed is none other than Mu Zhong.
Mu Zhong: the heartthrob of Challenger University, born with supernatural talent, and a prospective member of the Dragon Team’s Sixth Squad. He was set to officially join after acquiring a second extraordinary ability in the [Highway Survival Challenge] .
However, in a recent mission, Mu Zhong was unexpectedly crippled, losing even his supernatural abilities.
His final value lies in a commercial marriage alliance with the legitimate heir of a second-tier family, stripped of his inheritance rights.
The day after their wedding, Wei Huan enters the [Highway Survival Challenge] and successfully obtains a god-tier extraordinary ability.
But then…
[Ding!] 
[Family member requests to join: Mu Zhong wishes to board. Do you accept?] 
Content Warnings:
1. This is a main-attack story. The protagonist isn’t selfish; having returned from a shattered world, he understands the importance of mutual support, leaning slightly toward a saintly disposition.
2. The protagonist will rise to become a leader of humanity, so his major decisions may sometimes appear ruthless.
3. Those who board his vehicle, regardless of initial conflicts, will never betray him once aboard. This isn’t a flaw, so feel free to emotionally invest in every teammate.
4. Occasionally reserved, the protagonist relies on his wife as his spokesperson. He deeply loves his wife, and his wife loves him back. Their romance is smooth, focusing on an unstoppable husband-and-wife duo dominating the world together.

125948.synopsis:
The Rift descends, and doomsday dungeons begin to spawn randomly!
All of humanity is forcibly drafted. Awakened ones rise to the top, while ordinary people become cannon fodder.
Office drone Lin Yu transmigrates into the body of a broke high school senior—
He starts on Hell Mode: burdened by massive debt from his sick mother, fails his awakening ritual, and is branded a useless loser.
In the final survival exam for seniors, participants are forcibly assigned to dungeons.
He’s “lucky” enough to be matched with his childhood friend and campus belle, Su Qingxue—
She’s awakened a rare class: Combat Medic!
Their team also includes three elite Awakened teammates.
The result?
Su Qingxue stays indifferent, and the elites scorn him.
The moment they step into the zombie city, Lin Yu is mercilessly abandoned as dead weight!
The livestream bullet screen mocks him:
【This loser won’t last an hour!】
【Bet he’ll be the first one feeding the zombies!】
Facing bloodthirsty zombies and timed corpse waves alone, just as Lin Yu hits rock bottom—
【Ding! Survival Radar System Activated!】
Within a 5km radius, no resource point can hide!
White = Food, Green = Medicine, Blue = Firearms…
He shuts off the livestream and quietly racks up fortune.
In the depths of an abandoned vault, he discovers god-tier loot that shouldn’t even exist in beginner dungeons—
【Space Backpack (Small)】!
When Su Qingxue’s team is surrounded and screams for help on stream…
When other players go mad fighting over scraps at the evacuation point…
Lin Yu, with his space pack on his back, moves like a ghost through the death-ridden city.
To his radar eyes, the world is full of treasure, and danger has nowhere to hide.
From then on, the apocalypse bore witness to the rise of a legend—
The Scavenger King.

129276.synopsis:
Do Hyeonjun has been in a one-sided love with Kim Chaeyeon for a long time. However, he already had a special person named Seo Jeong.
He thought he would be happy just watching from the sidelines, but Hyeonjun ends up spending an unexpected heat cycle with Chaeyeon and even becomes one-sidedly imprinted on him.
“Do Hyeonjun, that’s your problem. It has nothing to do with me.”

Chaeyeon, who despises being subservient to his instincts as a person with manifested traits, pushes Hyeonjun away with words as sharp as a blade. A terrible agony began, so much so that he felt his hopeless one-sided love was happier in comparison.

132860.synopsis:

“General Kang is going to discard you. I heard his fiancée, the healer, will replace you.”
A world where brain-eating “infected” run rampant, and “Awakened” and “Healers” who use special powers coexist.
A healer and the only carrier, Subject A, makes a decision.
Before she becomes useless and is discarded, she will run away first.
***
“General Kang, are you engaged? Is that person… a healer too?”
“Why does that matter?”
“If that person is a healer, then I won’t be needed any longer. I want to be free now.”
“Whether I’m engaged to a healer or married to an infected, nothing changes. You’ll keep living beside me as you always have.”
Kang Hyunho’s ink-black eyes gleamed with a dangerous light.
I go out of my way and suffer to keep you hidden, and you dare talk about leaving me?
After all the lengths I’ve gone because you were pretty, is this the thanks I get?
“What exactly do you want from me?”
He couldn’t hide his weariness. The question itself—what she wanted—was misplaced.
Honestly, Bangul needed to learn her place from this opportunity.
“Bangul. If it weren’t for me, you’d have been dead already.”
Before she knew it, he whispered as he roughly grabbed her chin.
“So strictly speaking, all of you already belong to me.”
The warm tenderness that had filled Kang Hyunho’s eyes until a moment ago was replaced by a cold smile on his lips.
“But what could I want from you? No… if I did want something, what could you possibly give me?”
“…What?”
“From the start, none of it was yours. Your body, a single strand of your hair, the breath you exhale… it’s all my property.”
Escape or Theft.
To flee and break free or to steal and take away.

162812.synopsis:
The Demon Lord, Li Xingji, met his end alongside the Heavenly Demon. Yet, when he opened his eyes again, he found himself cast back into the past. To his surprise, this world already had a “him”—the brilliant, moonlit Immortal Lord, Li Xingzhou, a man revered by all.
Li Xingji’s plan was simple: use his knowledge of the future to get close to his counterpart and steal his identity.
There was just one problem. This “other self” seemed convinced that Li Xingji was actually a manifestation of his own Inner Demon.
What was even stranger? After making the mistake, the man didn’t try to exorcise his demon. Instead, he seemed intent on… keeping him?
Heh. Now this is getting interesting.
Li Xingzhou escaped the secret realm and, on a whim, saved a stranger’s life.
He didn’t expect to walk away with his own “Inner Demon” in tow.
Watching the demon before him—eyes burning with ambition and clearly possessing a mind of its own—Li Xingzhou felt a sudden, strange flicker in his heart.
He had worn a mask of perfection for far too long. If he kept this demon as his own private plaything, wouldn’t that satisfy his darkest urges without anyone ever finding out?

Liu Sizhao was very wealthy, but he had never thought about investing in real estate. He had simply come to the countryside of Nanshi to recuperate from his illness.
When she should have been currying favor with a potential buyer, Zhuyu always seemed to be just a little lacking in social awareness.
